verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Shortwave can be self-hosted or that users can run their own mail pipeline. Community reports describe it as a hosted service that syncs mail to Shortwave's servers and uses Gmail's APIs rather than IMAP.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
